status: Local untracked review artifact; no implementation acceptance or production claim
scope: Current application GET dispatch and the three current UX audits, plus two read-only account-form captures. Static marketing pages, prototype pages, static assets, POST-only actions and past release screenshots are not counted as active GET screens.
count_rules: HTML route coverage requires at least one accepted visual state, including invalid authorization for /oauth/authorize; it does not mean its successful workflow is audited.
Query variants share their registered path. Full-page and focused images are not extra routes.
The /tables handler is JSON, /reports/export is CSV and / is a redirect; none is an HTML product screen.
Pre-router canonical health/API/MCP/metadata GET endpoints are counted separately. Unknown wildcard URLs and metadata suffix aliases are not additional named endpoints.
Generic HTTP 404, POST-only GET 405 and expired demo 503 are supplemental global states, not extra HTML routes.

summary.coverage_claim: All 38 HTML route paths have at least one accepted captured state at 1440/768/390. Workflow, successful OAuth, error, permission, accessibility and financial validation remain incomplete.
